section: Make in India, PLI schemes, National Manufacturing Policy; ease of doing business reforms

accepted.s: India’s position in mobile phone manufacturing is best described as follows:
o: The second-largest mobile phone manufacturer in the world
The fifth-largest mobile phone manufacturer in the world
The largest mobile phone manufacturer in the world
The third-largest mobile phone manufacturer in the world
accepted.x: India is identified as the second-largest mobile phone manufacturer.
accepted.tq: Use the precise rank rather than assuming that the largest domestic market is the largest manufacturer.
accepted.sec: Electronics and semiconductors - mobile rank, Semicon plants and locations  [other exams]

accepted.s: The output of mobile phones in India increased from approximately ₹18,900 crore in 2014–15 to what level in 2024–25?
accepted.x: Mobile phone output rose from ₹18,900 crore in 2014–15 to ₹5.45 lakh crore in 2024–25.
accepted.tq: Match the figure with the correct sector and year range.
accepted.sec: Electronics and semiconductors - mobile rank, Semicon plants and locations  [other exams]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding India’s electronics and mobile phone sector:
1. About 99.2% of the mobile phones used in India are made domestically.
2. Smartphones became India’s largest export category in 2025.
3. Electronics output rose from ₹1.90 lakh crore to ₹11.32 lakh crore over the period specified.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: domestic production accounts for 99.2% of phones used in India, smartphones were the largest export category in 2025, and electronics output increased from ₹1.90 lakh crore to ₹11.32 lakh crore.
accepted.tq: Check each numerical and sectoral statement separately before selecting the combined option.
accepted.sec: Electronics and semiconductors - mobile rank, Semicon plants and locations  [other exams]

accepted.s:
With reference to the India Semiconductor Mission (ISM), consider the following statements:
1. Twelve projects have been approved under the Mission.
2. The approved projects involve commitments of about ₹1.64 lakh crore.
3. Capital assistance under the Mission may extend up to 50 per cent.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: ISM approved 12 projects involving about ₹1.64 lakh crore of commitments, and capital assistance may extend up to 50%.
accepted.tq: Combine the project count, financial commitment and assistance ceiling only after verifying each statement.
accepted.sec: Electronics and semiconductors - mobile rank, Semicon plants and locations  [other exams]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly represents the State-wise distribution of the approved ISM projects mentioned below?
o: Gujarat–6, Odisha–2, Assam–1, Uttar Pradesh–2, Punjab–1 and Andhra Pradesh–0
Gujarat–6, Odisha–1, Assam–2, Uttar Pradesh–1, Punjab–1 and Andhra Pradesh–1
Gujarat–6, Odisha–2, Assam–1, Uttar Pradesh–1, Punjab–1 and Andhra Pradesh–1
Gujarat–5, Odisha–3, Assam–1, Uttar Pradesh–1, Punjab–1 and Andhra Pradesh–1
accepted.x: The distribution is Gujarat 6, Odisha 2, and one each in Assam, Uttar Pradesh, Punjab and Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Add the State-wise figures and reject options that shift one project between States.
accepted.sec: Electronics and semiconductors - mobile rank, Semicon plants and locations  [other exams]

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II:

List-I (Unit)
(a) Tata Electronics–PSMC wafer fabrication plant
(b) Tata OSAT
(c) Micron ATMP unit
(d) Tata Semiconductor Assembly & Test OSAT

List-II (Location)
(i) Jagiroad, Assam
(ii) Dholera, Gujarat
(iii) Sanand, Gujarat
(iv) Morigaon, Assam

Select the correct answer using the code given below:
accepted.x: The PSMC wafer fab is at Dholera, Tata OSAT at Morigaon, Micron ATMP at Sanand, and Tata Semiconductor Assembly & Test at Jagiroad.
accepted.tq: Start with the sure location pairs and eliminate codes that repeat or misplace the Assam units.
accepted.sec: Electronics and semiconductors - mobile rank, Semicon plants and locations  [other exams]

accepted.s: Which of the following statements regarding semiconductor facilities is NOT correctly matched?
o: First commercial GaN micro-LED display fab — Morigaon, Assam
accepted.x: The first commercial GaN micro-LED display fab is located at Dholera, not Morigaon. The other three pairs are correctly matched.
accepted.tq: Find the single wrong location by comparing each facility with its stated site.
accepted.sec: Electronics and semiconductors - mobile rank, Semicon plants and locations  [other exams]

accepted.s: The enhanced allocation for the Electronics Components Manufacturing Scheme (ECMS) in Budget 2026–27 is:
accepted.x: The ECMS allocation was enhanced to ₹40,000 crore in Budget 2026–27.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the ECMS allocation from the separate ISM 1.0 outlay and plant investments.
accepted.sec: Electronics and semiconductors - mobile rank, Semicon plants and locations  [other exams]

accepted.s: India Semiconductor Mission 2.0 aims to achieve approximately what level of self-sufficiency by 2029?
accepted.x: ISM 2.0 targets 70–75% self-sufficiency by 2029.
accepted.tq: Identify the target range rather than confusing it with the capital-assistance percentage.
accepted.sec: Electronics and semiconductors - mobile rank, Semicon plants and locations  [other exams]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the institutional position and scope of the India Semiconductor Mission?
o: It functions under the Department of Commerce and supports only semiconductor imports.
It functions under the Digital India Corporation and supports fabs, OSAT/ATMP units and chip design.
It functions under the Reserve Bank of India and supports only mobile-phone assembly.
It functions under NITI Aayog and supports only electronics exports.
accepted.x: ISM operates under the Digital India Corporation of MeitY and supports fabs, OSAT/ATMP and chip design.
accepted.tq: Use the ‘who would do this job?’ method to identify the correct institutional role.
accepted.sec: Electronics and semiconductors - mobile rank, Semicon plants and locations  [other exams]

accepted.s: The e-Biz platform was introduced as which of the following?
o: A State-level portal exclusively for environmental clearances
A Mission Mode Project under the National e-Governance Plan for online registration, filing and payments
A World Bank index for measuring business regulations
An investment promotion joint venture between FICCI and CII
accepted.x: e-Biz is a Mission Mode Project under NeGP that enables online registration, filing and payment for businesses.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the function of a digital business service from an investment agency or ranking index.
accepted.sec: Single window systems - e-Biz, National Single Window System  [other exams]

accepted.s: The National Single Window System presently provides access to:
accepted.x: The National Single Window System provides access to 686 central and 7,498 State approvals.
accepted.tq: Keep the central and State figures in their correct order.
accepted.sec: Single window systems - e-Biz, National Single Window System  [other exams]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the National Single Window System:
1. The Foreign Investment Facilitation portal was merged with it in August 2022.
2. Udyam Registration for MSMEs was introduced in 2020.
3. It provides access only to central government approvals.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is false because the system provides access to both central and State approvals.
accepted.tq: Reject the absolute ‘only’ statement after checking the two-level approval coverage.
accepted.sec: Single window systems - e-Biz, National Single Window System  [other exams]

accepted.s: Invest India, established in 2009, is best described as:
o: A statutory regulator under the Reserve Bank of India for foreign exchange transactions
A World Bank Group index for ranking investment destinations
A not-for-profit joint venture involving DIPP, FICCI, CII, NASSCOM and the States, serving as the national investment promotion agency
A private company established exclusively by NASSCOM for software exports
accepted.x: Invest India was established in 2009 as a not-for-profit joint venture involving DIPP, FICCI, CII, NASSCOM and the States, and serves as the national investment promotion agency.
accepted.tq: Separate the investment-promotion agency from a regulator, index or private industry body.
accepted.sec: Single window systems - e-Biz, National Single Window System  [other exams]

accepted.s: Under the DPIIT Single Window Systems Guidebook (2025), the 80 services are classified as:
accepted.x: The Guidebook classifies 80 services into 44 essential and 36 desirable services.
accepted.tq: Check that the two categories add up to the total of 80 services.
accepted.sec: Single window systems - e-Biz, National Single Window System  [other exams]

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly states the principal purpose of the Jan Vishwas Act, 2023?
o: Ranking of States on business competitiveness
accepted.x: The Jan Vishwas Act, 2023 decriminalised minor offences to facilitate compliance and reduce the burden of criminal provisions.
accepted.tq: Match the Act with its core reform objective rather than its administrative platform.
accepted.sec: Single window systems - e-Biz, National Single Window System  [other exams]

accepted.s:
With reference to the Jan Vishwas 2.0 Bill, consider the following statements:
1. It was introduced on 18 August 2025.
2. It covered 16 Acts administered by 10 ministries.
3. It proposed decriminalisation of 288 provisions.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: the Bill was introduced on 18 August 2025, covered 16 Acts and 10 ministries, and proposed decriminalisation of 288 provisions.
accepted.tq: Verify the date, institutional coverage and provision count independently.
accepted.sec: Single window systems - e-Biz, National Single Window System  [other exams]

accepted.s: Under the Jan Vishwas Act, 2026, a first-time lapse under Legal Metrology attracts which measure before a penalty?
accepted.x: For a first-time Legal Metrology lapse, an Improvement Notice is issued before imposing a penalty.
accepted.tq: Apply the reform sequence: corrective notice first, penalty later.
accepted.sec: Single window systems - e-Biz, National Single Window System  [other exams]

accepted.s: PARIVESH 3.0 is intended to function as a single-window system for:
accepted.x: PARIVESH 3.0 serves as a single window for environmental clearances.
accepted.tq: Identify the subject handled by the portal from the nature of the clearance required.
accepted.sec: Single window systems - e-Biz, National Single Window System  [other exams]

accepted.s: The Andhra Pradesh Single Desk Portal was launched in:
accepted.x: The Andhra Pradesh Single Desk Portal was launched in April 2015.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the launch year from later performance and version details.
accepted.sec: AP Single Desk Portal and AP EoDB reforms

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the original design of the Andhra Pradesh Single Desk Portal?
accepted.x: The portal was designed to provide 93 clearances from 19 departments within 21 days.
accepted.tq: Keep the clearance count, department count and time limit in their correct positions.
accepted.sec: AP Single Desk Portal and AP EoDB reforms

accepted.s: During FY 2024–25, the Andhra Pradesh Single Desk Portal approved 16,458 out of 16,783 applications within the stipulated service-level agreement. The percentage was approximately:
accepted.x: The reported proportion of approvals within the SLA was 99.20%, representing 16,458 of 16,783 applications.
accepted.tq: Use the stated percentage together with the numerator and denominator to avoid a decimal-place trap.
accepted.sec: AP Single Desk Portal and AP EoDB reforms

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT an approval category under the Andhra Pradesh Single Desk Portal?
o: Automatic approval only after Cabinet approval in every case
Deemed approval when the SLA is breached
accepted.x: The portal includes self-certification, in-principle approval followed by post-inspection and deemed approval on SLA breach. Cabinet approval is not required in every case.
accepted.tq: Find the option containing an absolute procedural requirement not found among the approval categories.
accepted.sec: AP Single Desk Portal and AP EoDB reforms

accepted.s: If the stipulated service-level agreement is breached under the Andhra Pradesh Single Desk Portal, the application may receive:
o: Fresh submission only after judicial review
accepted.x: The portal provides for deemed approval when the prescribed SLA is breached.
accepted.tq: Apply the consequence of delay rather than confusing it with rejection or re-submission.
accepted.sec: AP Single Desk Portal and AP EoDB reforms

accepted.s: Which institution was empowered to allot up to 50 acres directly without Cabinet approval?
accepted.x: APIIC was empowered to allot up to 50 acres directly without Cabinet approval.
accepted.tq: Match the land-allotment power with the institution responsible for industrial infrastructure.
accepted.sec: AP Single Desk Portal and AP EoDB reforms

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding Andhra Pradesh’s ease-of-doing-business reforms:
1. The Investment Facilitation Cell works through liaison officers.
2. The AP Pollution Control Board has computerised inspections.
3. Green and White category units are exempt from routine inspection.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements correctly describe the stated AP reforms: liaison officers support facilitation, inspections are computerised, and Green and White units are exempt from routine inspection.
accepted.tq: Treat each administrative reform as an independent statement before choosing the combined code.
accepted.sec: AP Single Desk Portal and AP EoDB reforms

accepted.s: The World Bank’s Doing Business rankings were published by the World Bank Group, with the underlying concept associated with which institution?
accepted.x: The Doing Business concept was associated with the International Finance Corporation, the private-sector arm of the World Bank Group.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the World Bank Group’s private-sector arm from other international economic organisations.
accepted.sec: World Bank Doing Business - publisher, indicators, India's rank, discontinuation  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
Arrange the following editions of the Doing Business Report in chronological order according to India’s reported rank:
A. Doing Business 2018 — rank 100
B. Doing Business 2015 — rank 142
C. Doing Business 2020 — rank 63
D. Doing Business 2017 — rank 130
accepted.x: The chronological order is DB 2015, DB 2017, DB 2018 and DB 2020, corresponding to B, D, A and C.
accepted.tq: Arrange by edition year, not by the numerical value of India’s rank.
accepted.sec: World Bank Doing Business - publisher, indicators, India's rank, discontinuation  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: The improvement in India’s rank from Doing Business 2017 to Doing Business 2018 was:
accepted.x: India improved from rank 130 in DB 2017 to rank 100 in DB 2018, a jump of 30 places.
accepted.tq: Calculate the change from the two adjacent ranks rather than selecting the rank itself.
accepted.sec: World Bank Doing Business - publisher, indicators, India's rank, discontinuation  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly states the last reported edition and India’s rank in it?
accepted.x: Doing Business 2020 was the last edition, and India’s rank in it was 63.
accepted.tq: Check both the edition year and rank; the year 2021 is associated with discontinuation, not a new edition.
accepted.sec: World Bank Doing Business - publisher, indicators, India's rank, discontinuation  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: The World Bank discontinued the Doing Business reports in 2021 primarily after concerns relating to:
o: The complete withdrawal of all World Bank lending to India
The absence of any indicators relating to business regulation
A constitutional prohibition on international rankings
Data irregularities and ethical concerns involving staff influence on rankings
accepted.x: The reports were discontinued in 2021 following data irregularities and ethical concerns about World Bank staff influencing rankings.
accepted.tq: Link the discontinuation to the stated integrity concerns rather than to a change in the subject of the report.
accepted.sec: World Bank Doing Business - publisher, indicators, India's rank, discontinuation  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: In the Doing Business 2020 assessment, which of the following was identified among India’s weakest indicators?
accepted.x: Enforcing contracts and registering property remained among India’s worst indicators in Doing Business 2020.
accepted.tq: Separate the weakest indicators from the strongest indicators listed for the same edition.
accepted.sec: India's weakest and strongest indicators  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which combination consists entirely of indicators identified as strong for India in Doing Business 2020?
o: Protecting minority investors, getting electricity and construction permits
Getting credit, enforcing contracts and trading across borders
Starting a business, paying taxes and resolving insolvency
Enforcing contracts, registering property and paying taxes
accepted.x: Protecting minority investors, getting electricity and construction permits were identified as India’s strongest indicators in DB 2020.
accepted.tq: Separate the strong-indicator group from the weak-indicator group before evaluating the combinations.
accepted.sec: India's weakest and strongest indicators  [APPSC, GROUP-II]
